note: Assessments made by looking at the screenshots beside them, taken in headless Chromium 149 at 1280x800 and 390x844 after three Tab presses. They record a visual judgment; the test only checks that each assessment uses the rubric and agrees with its sample's label.

verdicts.composition: finding: controls in one line at the top, about 75% of the 1280x800 screen is empty background
verdicts.typography: finding: the Buy button and text box use the browser's default small font
verdicts.spacing: finding: radio buttons, text box and button run together with no grouping or frame
verdicts.depth: finding: flat background only, no frame, shadow or counter
verdicts.materials: finding: no carnival material; a bare table reads as a dashboard
verdicts.controls: finding: default grey button, default blue radio dots, white default text box with no label
verdicts.focus-contrast: finding: button:focus removes the outline, so the focused Buy button shows no ring

verdicts.composition: pass: the illustrated stall fills the left of the frame as the focal point; the counter panel beside it is filled by a price board and the form, centred, with no large empty area
verdicts.typography: pass: theme font throughout, gold headings, a letter-spaced price board title, controls inherit the font, bold labels and button
verdicts.spacing: pass: price board, radios, name field and button grouped in one framed counter with even gaps
verdicts.depth: pass: wood frame and drop shadow under the stall, a sky gradient, shaded awning, counter and shelves, a ground shadow under the stall and lantern glow
verdicts.materials: pass: scalloped red and cream striped awning, wood posts and plank counter with grain lines, glowing paper lanterns, bunting, balloons and plush prizes on shelves, a painted TICKETS sign
verdicts.art-integration: pass: the SVG scene shares the frame with its controls, the counter's striped top echoes the awning and both use only theme colours
verdicts.controls: pass: native radios, text box and button, all styled from the theme, labels associated
verdicts.responsive: pass: at 390px the scene scales down whole and the counter stacks under it, nothing cut off or scrolling sideways
verdicts.focus-contrast: pass: a 3px gold focus ring shows on the Buy button against the purple counter
